arStrings.szText: Huh? Oh, sorry wanderer, I was far away...listening to the whispers for one of the heads. I am worried for him.
Breaking out of a day dream. Concerned. Anxious.
His name is Fal'thane. He was one of the first druids to cross the sea to tame the wilds of Scosglen... I miss his stories.
In times of trouble, he liked to smoke on the bluffs overlooking the moors. I was about to go look for him there... You could meet me, if you'd like.
